title: Membership in the valid root label set
statement: Let $G$ be a finite unique game, let $C$ be a connected component, and let $a$ be one of the $q$ labels. Then $a$ belongs to the set of valid root labels for $C$ if and only if transporting $a$ along the chosen paths from the component root satisfies the compatibility condition for every constraint whose source lies in $C$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite unique game with finite nonempty vertex and constraint sets, distinct endpoints, and a permutation attached to each constraint
A label from the $q$-element label set is fixed
